title: Conditionals 0–2
recall: 0, 1 va 2-shart gaplarning tuzilishi va farqi nima? unless va in case qanday ishlatiladi?
formula: 0: if + present, present — fakt (If you heat ice, it melts)
1: if + present, will — real kelajak (If it rains, I'll stay home)
2: if + past, would — xayoliy hozir/kelajak (If I had money, I'd travel); If I were you…; unless = if not

pairs.a: If I have time, I'll call you.
pairs.b: If I had time, I'd call you.
If I see him, I'll tell him.

items.uz: Muzni qizdirsang, eriydi.
en: If you heat ice, it melts.

items.uz: Agar yomg'ir yog'sa, uyda qolaman.
en: If it rains, I'll stay at home.
I'll stay at home if it rains.
If it rains, I'll stay home.

items.uz: Agar pulim bo'lganda, dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilardim.
en: If I had money, I would travel around the world.
If I had money, I'd travel around the world.
I would travel around the world if I had money.

items.uz: Men sening o'rningda bo'lganimda, bu ishni olmasdim.
en: If I were you, I wouldn't take this job.
If I were you, I wouldn't take that job.

items.uz: Shoshilmasang, kechikasan.
en: If you don't hurry, you'll be late.
Unless you hurry, you'll be late.

items.uz: Agar u qo'ng'iroq qilsa, menga ayt.
en: If he calls, tell me.
If he calls, let me know.

items.uz: Agar ingliz tilini yaxshi bilganimda, chet elda ishlardim.
en: If I spoke English well, I would work abroad.
If I knew English well, I'd work abroad.
If my English were good, I would work abroad.

items.uz: Ko'p ishlamasang, imtihondan o'tolmaysan.
en: Unless you study hard, you won't pass the exam.
If you don't study hard, you won't pass the exam.

items.uz: Agar vaqtim bo'lsa, senga yordam beraman.
en: If I have time, I'll help you.
I'll help you if I have time.

items.uz: Agar sen bo'lmaganingda, nima qilardim?
en: What would I do if you weren't here?
What would I do without you?

items.uz: Yomg'ir yog'ib qolsa deb soyabon ol.
en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

items.uz: Agar avtobus kelmasa, taksi olamiz.
en: If the bus doesn't come, we'll take a taxi.
If the bus doesn't come, we'll get a taxi.

items.uz: O'simliklarni sug'ormasang, ular quriydi.
en: If you don't water plants, they die.
Plants die if you don't water them.

items.uz: Agar u yerda yashaganimda, har kuni dengizga borardim.
en: If I lived there, I would go to the sea every day.
If I lived there, I'd go to the beach every day.

items.uz: Agar tushlikdan keyin kelsang, men ofisda bo'laman.
en: If you come after lunch, I'll be in the office.
I'll be in the office if you come after lunch.

items.uz: U menga qo'ng'iroq qilmasa, xavotir olaman.
en: If he doesn't call me, I'll worry.
I'll worry if he doesn't call me.

items.uz: Sizda savol bo'lsa, so'rang.
en: If you have any questions, ask.
If you have any questions, please ask.

items.uz: Agar men boy bo'lganimda, katta uy sotib olardim.
en: If I were rich, I would buy a big house.
If I were rich, I'd buy a big house.
If I was rich, I would buy a big house.

items.uz: Kech qolmasang, birga ovqatlanamiz.
en: As long as you're not late, we'll have dinner together.
If you aren't late, we'll eat together.
If you're not late, we'll have dinner together.

items.uz: Agar men sening telefon raqamingni bilganimda, qo'ng'iroq qilardim.
en: If I knew your phone number, I would call you.
If I knew your number, I'd call you.

speak: Bu hafta oxiri ob-havoga qarab nima qilasiz? (1-shart) — 5 ta gap.
Agar 1 million dollar bo'lsa nima qilardingiz? (2-shart)
Do'stingizga 'If I were you…' bilan 3 ta maslahat.
